exposure: Falciparum malaria episodes during pregnancy (number and timing)
Vivax malaria episodes during pregnancy (number and timing)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 50,060 pregnant women receiving antenatal care on the Thailand-Myanmar border between 1986 and 2015.
finding: The odds of small-for-gestational-age increased linearly with each episode of falciparum and vivax malaria, and falciparum malaria after 24-28 weeks gestation was associated with increased odds of very or late preterm birth.
birth_weight: Small-for-gestational-age (SGA) was defined using international standards.
gest_age: Outcomes included very preterm birth (>=28 and <32 weeks) and late preterm birth (>=32 and <37 weeks) defined by WHO standards.
